task: Preserve lexical for-loop shadowing while closing an outer open Vector type.
observation: At base 7c3f18d, the compiler rejected a valid read-only loop over Vector[Int] when the loop variable shadowed an outer empty Vector later closed to String. Renaming only the loop variable made the same program check and run. The flat BodyTypeState local map let the inner use constrain or read the outer term before lexical restoration.
impact: The type diagnostic appeared at the inner use even though the source error was compiler scope contamination; a reduced native-safe regression was needed to isolate it.
evidence: ./moss check tests/for_shadow_open_type.moss --json at 7c3f18d: TYPE_MISMATCH on the first(values) call

resolution.summary: A scoped-term repair passes the reduced Moss check and native execution in an isolated worktree; broader regression validation is still in progress.
